# Fourier Series

Fourier proposed that any reasonable function can be written as:

$$
f(x) = \sum_{n=-\infty}^{\infty} c_n e^{inx}.
$$

At the time, this was controversial.

## A key insight

Even discontinuous functions can be represented using smooth waves.

## What went wrong?

Early mathematicians did not fully understand convergence:
- pointwise convergence
- uniform convergence
- divergence phenomena
